name: Symphony Holdings Limited
summary: Symphony Holdings Limited, incorporated in 1993 and based in North Point, Hong Kong, is an investment holding company running sports brands and retail in China, Hong Kong, the United States and elsewhere. It reports branding, retailing and financial services segments, covering the SKINS trademarks, outlet malls and fashion stores, swimwear and sportswear trading, and food and drink. It also provides securities brokerage, margin financing and asset management. It was formerly Liang Shing (Holdings) Limited.
